**ACCEPT** — contract-tier review of PR https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/16375, head `9a1f16843c` (skills seat, 2026-09-06T16:3xZ).

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-16262-os-dev-lock-discipline-and-finding-threshold` (os-dev subagent, contract tier — launched at tier, no refusal)
Reviewed-by: `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox` (skills seat)

Verified in a detached compare worktree at the PR head, not from the report:

- **One file, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, +11/−11, line-neutral at 403/403, every added line paid inside its own numbered block.** #16262 (the #14944 ruling's Q3 A half): rule 1 now states the waiting discipline as protocol — one foreground call takes the whole wait budget and blocks to the lock or 99, ⛔ no poll-and-retry, `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT` always set — with the arrival-order guarantee folded into the VERDICT line; rule 7 reads a 99 as NOT MEASURED, spends the interval on lock-free work (the example list corrected to 写测试 — running tests takes the lock), and makes the re-acquisition a same-slot resume, ⛔ never a tail re-entry. #16351's last half: rule 3's out-of-scope block carries the maintainer's admission threshold — only (a) a reproducible defect, (b) a declared-contract violation, (c) a metadata-authoring trap file a card, ⛔ never withheld for looking small; everything else (观察、死代码、未演练漂移、抛光、风格、文档 nit、命名) goes under the PR's `## 验收备注` and into the report as `noted, not filed`, read by the seat at ACCEPT — paid by folding the 立不成/禁形 pair and retiring the two old disposition lines; the dedup / channel / 归挂 lines stay for the cards that are filed; the report-shape example gains the second spelling in place. The seat read each deleted sentence against the survivors: no rule lost.
- **Gates at the head:** `check-skill-line-ratchet` exit 0 (os-dev.md 403/403, zero advisories); `check-governed-merges --test` exit **3**; `check-half-states --self-test` 2553 (fourteen removed or rewritten sentences pinned nowhere, positive controls fire); `check-skill-id-lint`, `check-skill-frame-sync` exit 0; all five `.claude/hooks/*.selftest.sh` exit 0; every added line 97–120 bytes; `git merge-tree` against flight B's PR #16357 (`f5c08e9589`, the same file) and against `main` exit 0 with the driver forced off. The dev's report adds the derived union 16/16 with `--ran` at 0 NOT-MEASURED, the formula-examples gate green after its build prerequisite, and whole-repo `pnpm lint` through the verify lock in one full-budget call. PR checks on `9a1f16843c`: 17 success, 12 skipped, 0 failed (29 runs, converged).
- **Report hygiene:** `os-dev-report` on #16262 and #16351, JSON closes; PR body opens `Fixes #16262` then `Fixes #16351` (this is #16351's last half; flight I's PR #16368 carries `Refs`); `## 验收备注` and `## 维护者速读(草稿)` present; no model identifier; `skip-changeset` read back comparatively; zero MCP calls; four `noted, not filed` items are the new rule applied to itself.

**Ruling on the open question — A, as landed.** A dev-filed card of the three classes carries no state label; the bare-card triage grades it (the fast path to `pm:queue` for a real defect), and `finding` stays a label seats apply — the type field remains the triage seat's single product (core-rules: 类型字段由分诊席唯一生产), and a dev that must not judge severity does not pick the routing label either. If the seats later want the 发现分诊轮 as the single grading path, it is one word on that line — a follow-up, not a re-dispatch.

Landing regime: governed (`.claude/**`) ⇒ the PR **stays a draft**; reviewers `os-zhuang` + `hotlong` requested in this same act, `needs-user-decision` added, the final 维护者速读 posted as the next comment; human merge. On the merge #16262 and #16351 close by `Fixes`; with PR #16368 the maintainer's finding-threshold instruction is then fully landed on both repos' reading surface.

## 维护者速读

**事情**:开发 agent 的工作合同 `os-dev.md` 一次落两条,行数不变(403/403)。① 验证锁的等待纪律写成协议(#14944 您裁的 Q3 A):一次前台调用领满预算、阻塞到拿锁或超时,不轮询重试,恒设 `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT`;超时读作「未测量」,再取时以同名续位而不是从队尾重排。② 您今天指示的 finding 准入门槛的后一半:dev 顺路发现只有三类立卡(可复现缺陷、契约违背、会让 AI 写错元数据的陷阱),其余写进 PR 的「验收备注」并在报告里记 `noted, not filed`,席位验收时复读。前一半(SKILL.md / core-rules / AGENTS.md)在 PR #16368。

**为什么改**:① 锁的等待方式此前只写了机制、没写成可追责的纪律,实测里守约者反而排不到;② 舰队每次飞行都立一到三张观察类卡、几乎全是 p3,队列只涨不消——从源头减流。

**代价与兜底**:纯文本规则,不碰代码与门禁;可能的代价是把本应立卡的缺陷记成备注,已用三类证据判据兜住,席位在验收时复读备注、实属三类的由席位补立。dev 立的卡不打状态标签、由分诊定级(席位已裁,与「类型标签由分诊席唯一产出」一致)。回滚即 revert 一个提交。

**席位意见**:建议合并。受管面(`.claude/**`),人工合并;合并后 #16262 与 #16351 关闭,您的准入门槛指示在两仓的阅读面上就全部落地了。

## Ruling on the open confirmation — filed cards stay UNTAGGED; triage grades (director seat, decision batch #63, 2026-09-07)

Maintainer reply, verbatim: 「同意」 (batch #63 recommendations adopted).

A card an `os-dev` files under the three-class admission threshold (reproducible defect / contract violation / a trap that makes an AI write wrong metadata) carries no `finding`, `domain:*`, type or priority label from the dev — routing and grading belong to the triage seat, exactly as the PR text stands. Everything outside the three classes goes to the PR's acceptance notes and is reported as `noted, not filed`; the accepting seat re-reads those notes and files anything that does belong to a class. No text change needed; ready for the maintainer's own merge (governed surface).
